utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll ask around with a few neighbors and see who’s available to help out. If you’ve got any details handy, send them my way and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — it’s just a small repair drive to fix a few things around the block. If you want, I can send along any details I have.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re collecting broken items for the repair drive this Saturday morning by the community hall. If you have anything small that needs fixing, bring it along and I’ll help sort it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep track of any neighbors who mention broken items and point them to the community hall Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — that would be a big help. If you hear of anything small that needs fixing, send them our way Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, the repair drive is on — I can help spread the word and connect anyone who wants to pitch in with Hana and Opal.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll point folks to Hana and Opal and keep nudging people to show up Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — I’m in if you still need me. Just let me know the pickup time and whether you want me to bring the wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I’ll let you know the pickup time as soon as it’s set, and yes, please bring the wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll keep track of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right? And who should I check with about what’s been gathered so far?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it’s still on — and you can check with me about what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s going really well so far—tools and supplies have been coming in all morning. I’ll keep an eye out for screwdrivers and extension cords for you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess—that’s a huge help. I’ll keep collecting the other tools, and if you spot a drill or hammer, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Gus—I’ll keep an eye out for a drill or hammer and let you know if I spot one.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds doable for me after school pickup—what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: After school pickup should work fine—come by Saturday morning around 10 at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 works for me—I’ll swing by after school pickup and help out before dinner.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll plan to be at the repair drive table by the community center at 4 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — just let me know the pickup time and what’s going first, and I’ll keep my plans set for 4 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit foggy on the details, but I can bring something small that needs fixing on Saturday morning by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good—Saturday morning by the community hall works. I’ll show you the fence panel and the loose step, and thanks again for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great — thanks, Uli. I’ll see you Saturday morning at the community hall and do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is going well—do they still need any tools or supplies? I can help look around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest—what still needs fixing, and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet—let me check what’s still needed and what time they’re meeting. If you want, I can ask around for the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what still needs fixing, and what time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll be there at 6 by the community room.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Rosa, I’m bringing the lamp by later today for the repair drive. Are you still able to take it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, please bring it by later today—I can take it. And just a reminder, the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll bring the lamp by later today. Sunday at the community center, got it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—count me in, and I can bring a wrench set if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, thanks Dane — a wrench set would really help. See you Saturday morning at the community hall!

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — and just to confirm, what time do you need the drill and tools sorted by?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi, I’m bringing the lamp by later today for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules. I’ll bring it by later today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re meeting this Saturday morning by the community hall to collect broken items for the repair drive. If you’ve got anything small that needs fixing, just bring it along and I’ll help sort it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can bring a couple small things. What time Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — let’s aim for 9 AM by the community hall. If anything comes up, just let me know and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the repair drive—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the pickup time, and that’s the main thing I’m trying to pin down before we start gathering anything. Once I know that, I can help sort what needs hauling.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — if you hear the pickup time, just let me know and I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can point you to the sorting table on Saturday morning. If there’s anything small that needs fixing, just bring it by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll head to the community hall Saturday morning and bring anything small that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate it — I’ll be at the community hall Saturday morning, and I’ll point you to the sorting table.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—what kind of repair drive is it, and what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re doing a neighborhood repair drive—mostly little fixes like the fence and a step that need patching up. If you can help, I can get you set up with gloves and tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps. I just want to confirm what needs patching before I start: is it mainly the fence and that step, or are there other small fixes too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds perfect — I can help after school pickup, but I’ll need to head out before dinner. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Come by around 4:30 if that works — I’ll have the list ready by then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 works for me — I’ll stop by after pickup and help for a bit before dinner.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll keep an eye out for any good screwdrivers or old extension cords and let you know if I spot them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess—that would be a big help. I’ll send around the updated details for Sunday at the community center so everyone knows where to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Rosa — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an eye out and pass along anything useful I find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll pass along any repair requests I hear while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’m a bit foggy, but I’ll bring something small that needs fixing to the community hall Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep listening for any other repair requests and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, send it over and I’ll get it out to everyone right away so we can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing — I’ll send you the list right away. Thanks for helping keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll share it with everyone as soon as it comes in so we can get those repairs moving.
